## Whole-home absence takes priority over room occupancy

When every configured home source confirms nobody is home, HEM now uses the
Away profile and treats the rooms as unoccupied without reading their
occupancy sources. This applies to person/device trackers, the selected
binary home entity and supported numeric home counters.

A stuck room sensor or a nonempty, stale, unavailable or malformed occupied-
rooms list can no longer override verified whole-home absence. An empty
occupied-rooms state is a valid empty list. While the home is verified Away,
an old empty state no longer causes **Room occupancy cannot be confirmed**
on every room or blocks absence-only device policies.

### Consistent decisions through departure and return

- Room profiles, device control, fan quiet behavior, ventilation and
  environmental vacancy history use the same home-first rule.
- The actual device-command check refreshes current home presence. Room
  sensors are no longer accidentally reused as whole-home trackers.
- Returning home resumes room checks even before the previous Away plan
  refreshes. A missing selected room sensor remains unknown, including when
  another selected sensor is off.
- A fresh positive configured home source still establishes Home. Missing,
  stale or unavailable home evidence is never treated as proof of absence.
- Installations with only room sources retain their existing Away cooldown
  and restart continuity. Explicit manual presets, sleep policies and physical
  device protections keep their existing behavior.

Regression coverage includes fresh and stale empty strings, contradictory
room readings, home-source uncertainty, departure and return transitions,
live device permission, legacy room trackers, fan quieting, environmental
history and presence continuity after restart. The existing runtime and
browser validation suite also runs for the release commit.

Update to **v0.6.0b113** in HACS and restart Home Assistant. Existing presence
selections are preserved; no configuration reset is required.
